name: Exp_ColorBearsGap
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBearsGap custom indicator, which identifies bearish gap patterns using dual smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal and sell positions when it transitions to a bearish signal, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBearsGap自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑算法识别看跌缺口形态。当指标从中性状态转为看涨信号时开多仓，转为看跌信号时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorBearsGap指标的颜色状态变化来捕捉动量转换。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从0（中性）变为大于0时触发买入信号，当从2（看跌）变为小于2时触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖反向信号平仓以及固定的止损和止盈设置，BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否在反向信号时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金等多种资金管理模式。资金管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的MarginMode枚举，提供从自由保证金到固定手数的五种模式选择。指标使用双重平滑（MA_Method1和MA_Method2），第一层为信号线平滑，第二层为信号线的再平滑，支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等十种平滑方法。默认在H8周期运行，SignalBar=1表示使用前一根已闭合K线的信号，避免重绘问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on color state transitions of the ColorBearsGap indicator to capture momentum shifts. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 1 transitions from 0 (neutral) to a value greater than 0, and a sell signal triggers when it transitions from 2 (bearish) to a value less than 2. Exit conditions rely on opposite signal closures plus fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters controlling whether positions close on reverse signals. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting fixed lots, balance percentage-based, and free margin-based money management modes. Money management uses the MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, offering five modes from free margin to fixed lot sizing. The indicator employs dual smoothing (MA_Method1 and MA_Method2), where the first layer smooths the signal line and the second re-smooths it, supporting ten methods including SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA. It defaults to H8 timeframe with SignalBar=1, using the previous closed bar's signal to avoid repainting issues.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平多仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平空仓

parameters.name: Phase2
parameters.description: 信号线再平滑相位参数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根闭合K线）

pros: 使用双重平滑算法减少假信号，信号质量较高
支持十种平滑方法灵活组合，适应不同市场环境
具备完整的止损止盈设置和滑点控制，风险可控
SignalBar=1默认使用已闭合K线信号，避免重绘问题
买入和卖出开关独立控制，灵活性好
H8大周期运行，过滤市场噪音能力强
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithm reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Supports ten smoothing method combinations for adaptability to different market conditions
Complete stop loss, take profit, and slippage control for manageable risk
SignalBar=1 defaults to closed bar signals, avoiding repainting issues
Independent buy/sell enable switches provide flexible control
H8 timeframe operation effectively filters market noise
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorBearsGap，指标源码不可见时难以验证逻辑
默认止损1000点、止盈2000点较大，在低波动品种上可能不合适
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能出现滑点过大问题
Recount机制在CopyBuffer失败时反复重试，可能在高频场景下造成延迟
没有多单同时持有的检查，可能在震荡行情中频繁开平仓
注释为乱码（编码问题），降低代码可读性和可维护性
cons_en: Depends on custom ColorBearsGap indicator; logic is unverifiable without its source code
Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are large and may not suit low-volatility instruments
No spread filter, which could cause excessive slippage in high-spread environments
Recount mechanism retries on CopyBuffer failure, potentially causing delays in fast markets
No check for simultaneous positions, potentially leading to frequent open/close cycles in choppy markets
Comments are garbled due to encoding issues, reducing readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停交易以避免滑点损失
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓或过于频繁的换仓操作
增加 trailing stop（移动止损）功能以更好地保护利润
修复源文件编码问题，恢复可读的中文注释
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when spreads are excessively wide
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries or excessive position flipping
Implement a trailing stop feature to better protect profits
Fix source file encoding to restore readable Chinese comments

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下止损止盈可能失效
没有持仓数量检查，可能在震荡市中频繁交易导致手续费侵蚀
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA无法运行
risk_points_en: No spread filter; stop loss and take profit may be ineffective in high-spread environments
No position count check; frequent trading in choppy markets can erode profits via commissions
Depends on external custom indicator; EA cannot operate if indicator fails to load
